say: Want to see everything a modern website can do?
Welcome to Byte+With+Sahnawaz. Let's take a full tour, section by section.
It starts with a clean first impression. Sahnawaz Ahmed Laskar, full-stack developer and UI designer, with quick buttons for recruiters, experience, live telemetry and search.
Next, the projects. Each one opens into a case study, with the problem, the lessons learned, and a live link.
These product cards are live. Yojana+Sahay tracks over twelve hundred schemes, and Study+Lens AI answers right from your browser. Nothing here is typed in by hand.
Where did the journey start?
In customer support at Xiaomi, then returns and refunds at Flipkart, and an IT and developer role at Rapido. Tap any role to read the full story.
Then come the key achievements. Over twenty-six hundred GitHub contributions, fifty plus web projects, and signature features like Hacker Mode. Every card opens its full story.
The tech stack can be filtered by frontend, backend, design and tools, each with a real proficiency level.
Certifications sit right below, and each one expands to show what it covered.
For technical reviewers, there's live engineering telemetry. Core Web Vitals are measured on your own device, during your visit.
Hiring for a role?
Paste the job description, and an AI checks it against real experience, then tells you honestly where it matches, and where it doesn't.
Need a website for your business?
Every service flips to show a clear starting price. Website design starts from nine thousand nine hundred ninety-nine rupees, and online stores from fourteen thousand nine hundred ninety-nine.
Not sure you need one? Ten cards explain why, for shops, clinics, restaurants, schools, creators and more.
Already have a website?
Run the free website check. In about thirty seconds, you'll see your phone speed, Google basics and WhatsApp preview, in English, Hindi, Bengali or Assamese.
Need just one skill? Book frontend, backend, UI design, CMS setup or SEO on their own.
Then come real words from managers and team leads at Xiaomi and Flipkart.
The blog shares real lessons, like why Yojana+Sahay's scheme data is open for everyone.
Have a question right now?
Ask our AI assistant about pricing, experience or availability. It replies instantly, day or night.
It's smart, too. It remembers your conversation, and suggests the next questions, so you always know what to ask.
Open Help for quick actions. Plan your project with AI, run a free website check, send a quick mail, get the resume by email, or request a callback.
Request a callback, and the assistant simply asks your name, your number, the reason, and a good time to call. That's it. We'll call you back.
Prefer to reach us directly? Email, WhatsApp, Instagram and LinkedIn are all one tap away.
You can also reach us beyond the website. Email S H Z the digital alchemist at gmail dot com, or WhatsApp plus nine one, six zero zero two four, four six one four eight.
Byte+With+Sahnawaz. Let's build your idea together. Visit sahnawaz portfolio dot vercel dot app.
